recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, rectangular graphic showcasing the 'Molex Shoora' font family. The central area features the font name in large, bold yellow letters. Surrounding this are smaller text elements in both yellow and white, some rotated vertically, providing details about the font. Four yellow sunburst icons are placed symmetrically at the corners of the central text block.
coreVisualRelationships: The large yellow 'Molex Shoora' text is the central focal point, drawing immediate attention.
The white text elements provide contrast and additional information, framing the central yellow text.
The yellow sunburst icons act as decorative accents and visual anchors at the corners.
The vertical text elements on the sides create a sense of enclosure and dynamic balance.
The black background provides a stark contrast, making the yellow and white text pop.
coreInvariants: Black background with high-contrast yellow and white text.
Central placement of the main font name in a large, decorative yellow typeface.
Symmetrical arrangement of four yellow sunburst icons.
Inclusion of both horizontal and vertically oriented text elements.
Use of multiple font styles (decorative, sans-serif, serif) to convey information.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The 'Molex Shoora' text occupies the central horizontal band, spanning approximately 60% of the width and 40% of the height. Surrounding text and icons are smaller and positioned to frame this central element.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow 'Molex Shoora' text serves as the primary visual anchor due to its size, color, and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn to the large central yellow text, then moves outwards to the surrounding white and smaller yellow text, often following the rectangular arrangement of information. The vertical text on the sides encourages a scanning motion.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space, primarily the black background, surrounds all text and graphic elements, allowing them to stand out clearly and preventing a cluttered appearance. This negative space is particularly prominent at the top and bottom edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black serves as the dominant background color, providing a canvas for the other elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow is the primary contrast color, used for the main font name and decorative icons, ensuring high visibility and impact.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White acts as an accent color, providing secondary information and a softer contrast against the black, complementing the yellow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The black is deep and desaturated, while the yellow is highly saturated and bright, creating a strong value contrast. The white is also bright, offering a clear, crisp contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, a specific shade of bright yellow, and white.
No gradients or complex color transitions.

adjustableVariables: Specific shades of yellow and white.
The exact decorative style of the main font.
The specific information presented in the surrounding text.
The shape and style of the decorative icons (e.g., sunburst, star, geometric shape).
The orientation and placement of the smaller text elements.
mustRedesign: The font name 'Molex Shoora' and associated branding 'Jolicia Type' must be replaced with new, original content.

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of all text elements against the background.
High contrast between text and background colors.
A distinct and memorable central typographic display.
avoid: Low contrast color combinations that hinder readability.
Generic or uninspired font choices for the main display.

postGenerationChecks: Is the main font name clearly the focal point?
Are the yellow and white elements distinct and readable against the black background?
Are the four corner icons symmetrically placed and consistent in style?
Is there a good balance between horizontal and vertical text elements?
Does the overall composition feel balanced and not top-heavy or bottom-heavy?
Are all informational text elements clearly legible and appropriately sized?
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a black rectangular canvas. Place a large, decorative, and bold font name in a bright, saturated yellow in the center. Frame this central text with smaller informational text in both white and the same yellow, some oriented horizontally and some vertically. Add four symmetrical decorative icons (e.g., sunbursts) in the same bright yellow at the corners of the central text block. Ensure ample negative space for clarity.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The design features two primary typographic styles: a bold, high-contrast display serif with flared terminals and a more delicate, script-like sans-serif. Both styles exhibit a playful, somewhat retro or art nouveau influence.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a bold, decorative serif with a light, fluid sans-serif to create visual interest and hierarchy. The serif is used for primary display, while the sans-serif provides supporting information and decorative framing.
graphicDevices: Stylized sunburst/starburst icons used as decorative separators and accents.

preserve: The high contrast between the two main typefaces.
The decorative, somewhat retro/art nouveau feel of the display serif.
The fluid, calligraphic quality of the sans-serif.
The use of vertical text for framing elements.
The color palette of yellow and white on a dark background.
avoid: Using generic sans-serifs for the decorative text.
Using serifs without strong decorative elements for the main display.
Overly complex backgrounds that compete with the typography.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Art Nouveau Display Serif + Script/Calligraphic Sans-Serif
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ornate, high-contrast display and the fluid, elegant supporting text. Look for serifs with strong flaring and sans-serifs with a hand-drawn or brush-like quality.

Reflects the playful, somewhat psychedelic curves of the main display and the relaxed, flowing nature of the secondary text. Serifs with exaggerated terminals and sans-serifs with soft, rounded forms would work.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Modern Decorative Serif + Elegant Humanist Sans-Serif
candidateDirections.reason: Maintains the strong display presence and the readability of the supporting text, while allowing for a more contemporary interpretation. Serifs with unique details and sans-serifs with open forms and good legibility.
If an exact font match for the display serif is difficult, custom lettering for key display elements could capture its unique character, paired with a carefully chosen sans-serif for supporting text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid, dark (e.g., black or very dark gray) rectangular background. Do not add any text or graphic elements at this stage.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the background with the following typographic elements: 1. A large, bold, high-contrast display serif in yellow for the primary central text, with tight tracking and leading. 2. A lighter, fluid, decorative sans-serif in white for the framing text at the top and bottom, with normal tracking. 3. The same display serif, in white, rotated 90 degrees clockwise and set vertically with loose tracking, for the left and right framing elements. 4. Smaller instances of the decorative sans-serif in yellow for corner metadata. 5. Place stylized sunburst/starburst icons in yellow as decorative separators and accents, ensuring they are visually balanced with the text.

verificationChecks: Are the two primary typefaces distinctly different in style and weight?
Is the main display text visually dominant and central?
Are the framing texts clearly secondary but still decorative?
Is the color contrast between text and background strong and legible?
Are the decorative elements (sunbursts, vertical text) integrated harmoniously?
